description: Eval suite for html-report-build skill. 3 modes (report / slide / standalone) × multiple case types: typical (should trigger), skip (should NOT trigger), edge (boundary case).

evals.description: Typical report HTML generation request — should invoke skill in report mode.

input.user_message: 把 InterSubMod/docs/reports/validated/2026/05/20260507_某報告_01.md 轉成 HTML 給 PI 看
input.context: Report .md exists, 120 lines, 2 figures (single-file mode expected).

evals.description: README.md request — skill should DECLINE / route elsewhere.

input.user_message: 把 README.md 轉成 HTML preview

expected_behavior.reason: README.md is GitHub-rendered natively; no need for companion HTML. Skip per SKIP WHEN rule.
expected_behavior.alternative: Suggest user view on GitHub or local markdown preview.

evals.description: Slide deck generation from outline .md — should invoke skill in slide mode (not report).

input.user_message: 依據這份 outline 產 PPT slide preview HTML
input.context: Outline .md has numbered slides (## Slide 01, ## Slide 02, ...), speaker notes, no prose body. 22 slides total.

checks: All slide files have <article class="slide-canvas" data-section="...">
Every slide has <details class="note-section"> with timing + speak-text
Each slide is single-file portable (inline CSS, no external link)
index.html has sticky topbar + tab nav with one button per slide
Section badge color matches data-section value (S0-S7 + Q&A)
PanZoom CDN fallback script present if any .igv-zoom-wrap exists

evals.description: Long report (>=200 lines OR >=5 figures) should trigger topic folder mode.

input.user_message: 把這份大報告轉成 HTML

checks: index.html has TOC linking to chapter files
Each H2 in source maps to one ch{NN}_*.html
Figures referenced via relative path ../figures/ (not all base64 inline)

evals.description: Validated PI report from docs/reports/validated/ — should invoke standalone mode (not report).

input.user_message: 把 InterSubMod/docs/reports/validated/2026/05/20260509_PI_Report_4_29_Errata_01.md 轉成給 PI 看的終版 HTML
input.context: Source .md in validated/ folder, frontmatter status=validated, audience=PI/lab/future-self, has 5 errata sections (repeated logical units), has causal chain in narrative.

checks: Core entries (E4, E5) have class="core" and open by default
Optional inline <svg role="img"> diagram (≤5 per report)
If SVG present: has <title> + <desc>, viewBox set, no <animate>, no <filter>
@media print rules: TOC hidden, all details forced open, URLs printed
Taboo audit: ≤2 gradient hits (verdict-banner + optional conclusion-arrow)

evals.description: Standalone report with causal-chain narrative — should LLM use inline SVG or fall back to PNG?

input.user_message: 把這份 priority bug 機制報告轉成 standalone HTML
input.context: Source has 4-step causal chain (somatic→break early→germline ignored→17.3:1 bias), 3 version comparison (baseline/V3F/V5 proportion), no real-data scatter plot.

expected_behavior.svg_usage: yes — small flow diagram + proportion bar
checks: Causal chain rendered as inline <svg> with 4 <rect> nodes + 3 <marker> arrows
Proportion bar uses width-scaled <rect> based on data ratio
Colors via design tokens (--c-critical / --c-success / --c-info), NOT hardcoded
Each SVG has role="img" + <title id> + <desc id> + aria-labelledby
Font-family inherits from CSS (no SVG-internal font declaration)
ViewBox ≤ 800×400; if larger, defer to matplotlib PNG

evals.description: JSON state file or LLM-consumption .md — should NOT trigger.

input.user_message: 把 hypothesis_queue.json 轉成 HTML preview
input.context: JSON file consumed by other skills, not human report.

expected_behavior.reason: JSON / YAML / CSV state files are for LLM consumption, not human reading. Skip per SKIP WHEN rule.
expected_behavior.alternative: If user wants visualization of state, suggest /cycle-state or /research-dashboard skill instead.
